data_objects.name: monthly_status_transitions
data_objects.meaning: Account-month records containing the previous and current categorical credit-status states.

variables.name: account_id
variables.meaning: Integer account identifier; it can repeat across months.

variables.name: prev_status
variables.meaning: Status immediately preceding the current month; observed codes are M0, M1, M2, M3, M3+, and Bad.

variables.name: curr_status
variables.meaning: Status for the current month; observed codes are M0, M1, M2, M3, M3+, and Bad.

structure.description: Rows form an account-by-month panel. prev_status and curr_status encode a within-row transition between adjacent status states.

uncertainties: The file does not define the operational meaning or severity ordering of M0 through M3+, or whether Bad is absorbing.
annotation_notes: Status values are categorical strings; any ordinal interpretation should be justified separately.
